A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] was the '''father''' of an [[Unidentified Serennian count|heir]] and served as [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] and Head of one of the six [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Count/Legends|Count]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by his son, when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] forced the heirs of the Great Houses of Serenno to [[Cleansing of Serenno|assassinate]] their [[Parent/Legends|fathers]] and take their place.<ref name="AOTE2" />
